analysis: Documentation-only change to docs/reference/configuration.md. The visible patch rewrites the intro (head lines 5-7) and replaces the retained-console variable table (base 84-99) with a pointer to darkbloom-platform's console-ui (head lines 82-85). This removes docs for NEXT_PUBLIC_* build-time variables; it changes no provider code or runtime controls. The base-side prefix-cache rows (base 672-685, e.g. DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_ALLOW_EPHEMERAL, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_TEST_ROOT, the DEBUG-only DARKBLOOM_DEBUG_CACHE_KEY_FILE) are outside the changed ranges ([5,7] and [84,99] on base), so the T-041 and TB-007 cache posture is unaffected. The head text I reviewed (lines 1-314) has the add-on hold, endpoint-resumption, logout and App Attest worker sections unchanged. Their stated posture is consistent with the canonical TB-011, TB-012, T-053 and T-059 text: worker opt-ins use exact 1, only the worker flag is forwarded to launchd, no local trust is created and no proof lifetime is extended. I saw no weakened control, no new attack surface and no invalidated threat assumption. Limits: the patch excerpt is truncated and the head text ends at line 314, so the rest of the head file and the console-ui documentation destination were not reviewed. Whether the console-ui source and its docs actually moved to the platform repo is an external contract I could not check from this evidence. I recorded it as unverified rather than as a finding.
